name: How to date a Sleep Paralysis Demon
source:
Dust is a jobless man who is really bored. He check on the internet and find a way to meet Sleep Paralysis Demon. He need to survive by any means necessary whether through avoiding, fighting, or.. even dating?! You will learn more about the main character and the monster, why do they like this and is it even possible for them to get together?

[From [url=https://sfour-s4.itch.io/how-to-date-a-sleep-paralysis-demon]Itch.io[/url]]
